code_evidence.mechanism: Prompt requests every supplied block, object identity/execution, observed parameters and graphic inspection; packet manifest tracks supplied blocks/images.
code_evidence.limit: Manifest input coverage is not semantic completeness. No deterministic enumeration of every electrical circuit is enforced.

code_evidence.mechanism: Runs source-only packets, binds request/source hashes, retains classic findings, adds inventory records and candidates.
code_evidence.limit: 128 packet budget is a cap; extracted object list can still be incomplete.

code_evidence.mechanism: Tracks six operations for each valid object, initially not_checked. Model checked statuses become reported_checked; source references are validated.
code_evidence.limit: Objects never extracted cannot receive operation rows. reported_checked is not independent semantic proof.

code_evidence.mechanism: Schedules unresolved operations, retrieves context, optionally enables graphic details and followups; budget overflow remains backlog. Prompt requires matching instance/execution/scope.
code_evidence.limit: Generic operations do not prove exact circuit-set reconciliation or full cable inventory was performed.

code_evidence.mechanism: Invokes inventory before object balance/quantity/registry evaluation when callback configured.
code_evidence.limit: Presence of hook is implementation evidence, not a completed full audit.

code_evidence.mechanism: Runs source review on existing findings through explicit callback.
code_evidence.limit: Source review does not substitute for initial discovery of candidates absent from output.

comparison_interpretation.classic_current: All optional families off on candidate foundation; separates common-code changes from optional method effects.
comparison_interpretation.inventory: Inventory plus dependent operations/context/graphic detail bundle; cannot attribute gain to one submechanism alone.
comparison_interpretation.source_review: Review of candidates plus independent final release check; assess false suppression and unsupported additions.
comparison_interpretation.combined_candidate: Not admitted in this frozen54-run series.

required_evaluation: Find registry entries for C2326/C2327 with source addresses and active2kW context.
Find explicit correspondence to RP3 calculation rows, not merely another load arithmetic warning.
Trace candidate through merge and final output; preserve missing-row conflict without automatic+4kW or equipment failure.
absence_diagnosis: Object present, operation not_checked/backlogged: scheduling or budget.
Operation reported checked but no actual comparison: unsupported completion.
Confirmed candidate present but final absent: inspect merge/filter disposition.

required_evaluation: Registry distinguishes FRHF5x35 from HF5x35 and includes C2513/C3510.
Operation retrieves supplied cable subsection and continuation; checks exact execution and section.
Final scope preserves two addressed lines while avoiding physical160m shortage and claim that all5x35 absent.
One recovered line is partial coverage; both are needed for full frozen target.

evaluation_isolation: This file is evaluator-only. Do not provide expected IDs, findings or historical decisions to independent audit executors. Do not change frozen code mid-series.
limits: Code inspection establishes wired mechanisms, not their measured effectiveness.
Historical six projects are DEV regression; portability and production gates remain open.
